div.head: PRAAT Seminar
div.p: 13th-14th October 2022: Phonology expert Dr. Fabio Gasparini will deliver a 2-day seminar for all the members of WIBARAB on how to use PRAAT to resolve phonetic problems in the recordings accumulated during fieldwork.
